name: Lofty
positioning: An all-in-one platform where the IDX website, the ad spend and the CRM are the same product, so a click is tracked to a closing.
description: Lofty bundles an IDX website, lead-generation advertising, CRM, dialer, email and SMS marketing, and transaction tracking into one subscription. Renamed from Chime in 2023. Sold mostly to teams and brokerages that want a single vendor rather than a stack.
real_estate_use: A team buys traffic through Lofty's ad management, the visitor lands on a Lofty IDX site, their property searches are recorded against their CRM record, and an AI assistant opens the conversation by text. The differentiator in daily use is behavioural triggering — the agent is alerted when a contact revisits a listing or saves a search, not on a calendar timer.
features: IDX website with agent, team and brokerage templates
Behavioural lead alerts driven by on-site property search activity
AI assistant that texts and qualifies inbound leads
Built-in dialer, SMS and drip email campaigns
Facebook and Google ad management with lead attribution

use_cases.job: Run lead generation, nurture and site under one vendor with one attribution report
Get alerted the moment a past lead resumes searching and re-engage the same day
